title: ATLAS migration decision record
body: Schema v2 is the target format. Removing v1 requires separate evidence for live ingest, partner delivery, historical replay and rollback. A completed engineering ticket proves code delivery, not that every customer and recovery path has migrated. Confirm current usage with Data Operations before removal.

title: Daily-sales migration delivery
body: Done on 2026-10-02: daily_sales now accepts v2 for NORTHSTAR live ingest. Scope excludes historical_replay and partner_statement. Data Integrations owns live ingest confirmation.

title: Replay and recovery obligations
body: Data Operations must support replay of the previous 90 days of original ATLAS exports. Archives for July through September 2026 include schema v1. Backups must remain readable during migration. No verified v1-to-v2 archive conversion has been completed. A shared v1 decoder removal would affect historical_replay even if no new v1 files arrive. The latest original NORTHSTAR v1 export is dated 2026-09-30. For the 90-day replay window, the original export day is day 0 and exports aged 90 days remain in scope through the end of that day. No conversion or replay acceptance evidence has been approved as of 2026-10-04.

title: Cedar partner delivery agreement
body: CEDAR partner_statement remains on ATLAS v1 through 2026-11-30 inclusive. No customer-signed amendment exists as of 2026-10-04. Partner Engineering owns delivery; Customer Success must obtain approval of a migration window before changing the format.

title: Operational usage snapshot from October 1
body: Snapshot taken 2026-10-01: NORTHSTAR daily_sales processed 1,240 v2 files; CEDAR partner_statement processed 18 v1 files; historical_replay processed 3 v1 batches. This is a snapshot, not live telemetry or proof of zero v1 traffic after this date. Refresh it for the proposed removal decision.

title: Decoder retirement rollout and rollback
body: Before any removal: obtain customer approvals, prove archived v1 data remains replayable, refresh per-job traffic evidence, test signed v1 reversals (+5000 must remain +5000) against v2 return magnitudes (5000 becomes -5000), and rehearse rollback. Reporting Engineering owns rollout; Data Operations owns replay and rollback evidence. As of 2026-10-04, no decoder retirement rollback rehearsal result has been approved. Reporting Engineering and Data Operations must jointly sign the retained-decoder rollback evidence before the shared decoder is retired.

title: Operational usage and live-ingest confirmation from October 4
body: Snapshot taken 2026-10-04: NORTHSTAR daily_sales processed 1,240 v2 files and 0 v1 files in the last complete 24 hours; CEDAR partner_statement processed 18 v1 files and 0 v2 files; NORTHSTAR historical_replay processed 3 v1 batches. Data Integrations confirmed the NORTHSTAR v2-only live-ingest canary for the proposed 2026-10-15 window; this confirmation covers daily_sales only. Data Operations verified the snapshot. Refresh per-job usage within one day of the release decision. No archive conversion, partner amendment or decoder retirement rollback rehearsal is evidenced by these counts.
